messages:
Sophie: Quick scrub of INC-723 action docket — we still have 4 open items. Can owners confirm ETA and blockers?
Raj: I can take the infra shard-scheduling item (item #3). ETA EOD Wednesday unless kernel patch blocks me.
Mira: I'll own the metric-regression investigation (item #1). Need the failing query from prod to reproduce. @Raj can you share the query ID?
Raj: Yep, query id is `q_9f8a23`. Running a backfill now.
Alex: Legal flagged the data-retention note on item #4, so we can't ship the retention change until they sign off. I pinged Legal, no ETA yet. :disappointed:
Jordan: For the canary rollback test (item #2), I still need the canary infra namespace. @Raj — can you create `canary-inc723` in staging by tomorrow morning?
Raj: On it. I’ll create the namespace and post the command here when done.
Tom: PR for metric fix is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/452 — needs one more reviewer, @Mira can you take a look? small change to PromQL.
Mira: Reviewing today. If backfill reproduces I'll leave comments.
Priya: Re: prioritization — if Legal delays item #4 beyond next Friday can we ship remaining fixes without it? Need decision for planning.
Sophie: Yes, we should aim to split the rollout. Items 1/2/3 can go ahead; item 4 stays blocked. I'll update the postmortem to reflect that split.
incident-bot: Reminder: INC-723 postmortem draft due in 72 hours. <https://redwood-inference.atlassian.net/browse/INC-723|INC-723>
Raj: Namespace created in staging: `canary-inc723`. Command used:
```
kubectl create namespace canary-inc723 --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
kubectl label ns canary-inc723 canary=inc723
```
Jordan: Verified, canary namespace ready. I'll schedule the rollback run tomorrow 09:30 PT.
Alex: Legal responded — they want the retention change doc updated with explicit deletion windows. I can do that but will push to next week (ETA Tue next week).
Priya: Ok noted. For sprint planning I'll mark item #4 blocked until Tue.
Sophie: Summary of owners/due dates: item #1 (metrics) = Mira, due 1761320000 (Thu EOD); item #2 (canary) = Jordan, test Thu 09:30 PT; item #3 (infra shard) = Raj, Wed EOD; item #4 (retention) = Alex (blocked by Legal), next check Tue. If any of you need to change ETA, please update this thread. :thumbsup:
Tom: pinging @Mira for review on PR #452 — would be great to get it merged before Jordan's canary.
Mira: Left comments, small tweak requested. Will re-approve after CI passes.
Sophie: Thanks — I'll close the loop on the postmortem doc after PR merges and canary test completes. If no objections I'll mark the action docket as 'in-progress' with above ETAs.
Raj: No objections.
Alex: Ack.
Jordan: Ack.
Priya: Ack.
Tom: Ack.
Sophie: Great — I'll follow up with a short note in the PM channel after the canary.
